title: Model fuse decision lattice and safety concierge for controlled degradations
creator: Aisha Mehta
description: Design and implement a decision-lattice based circuit fuse for models and dependencies plus a lightweight 'safety concierge' component that validates and authorizes fallback paths. Goal: enable per-model and per-tenant graceful degradations that preserve SLOs, provide deterministic rollback semantics, and guarantee safe multi-region failover without silent correctness regressions.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic decision lattice algorithm selects fallback candidates given (tenant, model, region, load, error-profile) and records the decision rationale in the trace for auditing.
Safety concierge validates candidate fallbacks against a policy matrix (compatibility, quality delta, data residency, rate limits) and rejects unsafe switches.
Trip logic implemented as soft and hard fuse states: soft (probabilistic shedding with TTL) and hard (route switch with hysteresis), with metrics exposing state transitions.
SLO-aligned trip thresholds: configurable per-tenant/per-model using EWMA of latency/error quantiles and an error-budget burn rate signal.
Multi-region failover integrates with routing layer: concierge annotates decisions so routing can prefer warm replicas and avoid cold-launch penalties.
Automated canary sequence for rollout: staged traffic percentages, automated rollback on quality regression, and post-mortem checklist created for any failover that exceeds threshold.
Documentation for operators and runbook for manual override accessible via Console and incident playbooks.
Unit and integration tests covering lattice decisions, concierge policy evaluation, and simulated region failovers.
Performance: decision path adds <2ms P50 overhead for 95% of requests; diagnostic path can be sampled at 0.1% by default.
updates: 2026-02-20 - Ticket created. Drafted requirements after on-call postmortem where a tenant experienced silent fallback to a lower-quality model during regional spike.
2026-02-24 - Architecture sync: agreed on separating decision lattice (stateless, fast) from safety concierge (stateful policy engine). Liam to prototype lattice; Aisha to author policy matrix draft.
2026-03-01 - Prototype: lattice picks top-3 candidates by a scored heuristic (latency delta, token-cost delta, compatibility). Running in shadow mode behind /route for two internal tenants.

2026-03-04 - Found trade-off: strict quality thresholds prevent useful load shedding under extreme load. Decided to add 'grace credits' where the concierge can allow temporary quality delta if error-budget is near exhaustion and tenant has opted-in.
2026-03-07 - Review feedback from PM (Noah Kim): add explicit data-residency check to reject fallbacks that cross jurisdictional boundaries. Added to policy matrix.
2026-03-10 - Integration test added: simulated europe region outage and verified concierge annotated decisions appear in traces; temporary soft trips applied and then healed by TTL.
Next - implement canary orchestration for rollout and build Console UI to display active lattice decisions and their rationale per tenant.
notes: Decision lattice scoring: sum of normalized features: latency_change_pct, token_cost_change_pct (negative preferred), compatibility_score (0-1), heuristic_penalty_if_unverified. We will store last-known quality delta for common fallbacks to avoid repeated regressions.

Soft trip semantics: probabilistic shed with decaying TTL. Example: when soft trip triggers, 20% of traffic is routed to fallback for 5 minutes, then 50% if metric doesn't improve, then escalate to hard trip if still violating.
Hard trip semantics: TTL + hysteresis windows with exponential backoff before re-evaluating, plus an automated dry-run window that probes primary at low RPS to check for recovery.

Safety concierge policy examples: deny fallback if quality_delta > 10% for regulated tenants, deny cross-region fallback when data residency flag is set, deny fallback if candidate is in Deploy-Queue or unvalidated canary.
Operational controls: per-tenant overrides via Console, emergency kill-switch for global disable, and audit log entries for every decision with trace_id, evaluated_features, and policy_outcome.

Monitoring: new metrics: lattice_decisions_total, lattice_decision_reasons, concierge_policy_rejections, soft_trip_rate, hard_trip_rate, recovery_probes_success_rate. Dashboards to be added to Console runtime SLO view.
Rollout plan: shadow mode (2 weeks) -> opt-in tenants (4 weeks) -> gradual global enable with 5% traffic increments and automated QA checks at each step.
